result.reason: The redline appropriately extends use to Affiliates and contractors acting on Licensee’s behalf and aligns the access restriction. However, it does not address perpetual and irrevocable treatment for paid-up licences, termination of subscription licences only for uncured material breach, or transfer to successors. Indeed, subsection (c) continues to prohibit assignment or transfer without an M&A-successor exception, so the clause does not reach even the full fallback position. The drafting is generally workable, though the direct grant to contractors should be expressly limited to services performed for Licensee and subsection (c) retains the existing typo 'operate and Licensed Technology.'
